title: Whoop header
description: A thin periwinkle announcement strip over a solid black 80px bar: a light, wide capital wordmark on the left, plain links in the middle on desktop, account and bag icons on the right. The bar sticks to the top while the strip scrolls away; on phones a menu icon slides a black drawer in from the left over a fading backdrop.
notes: the bar is position: sticky, so put the block first, directly in the page (not inside a short wrapper)
the bar is black in light mode and the card colour in dark mode
name: whoop-header

props.name: brand
props.description: brand name for the wordmark, and where it links

props.name: announcement
props.description: one line in the thin strip above the bar (leave out for no strip)

props.name: links
props.description: the links: in the middle of the bar on desktop, in the drawer on phones

props.name: menuLabels
props.description: screen-reader labels of the drawer's open and close buttons
